Rainbow plots of curves

plot_curves.Rd

Draws the curves coloured by time, from red (earliest) to violet (latest). type = "rainbow" draws all curves in one panel with a colour bar, and type = "periods" draws one panel per period with the other curves in grey.

Usage

plot_curves(
  x,
  type = c("rainbow", "periods"),
  periods = 5,
  argvals = NULL,
  xlab = "Grid",
  ylab = "Value",
  main = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A matrix of curves (grid points by time) or an fts object.

type

"rainbow" or "periods".

periods

Number of periods of equal length, or the first time point of each period, such as c(1901, 1921, 1941, 1961, 1981).

argvals

Grid values. Defaults to the row names of x if numeric.

xlab, ylab, main

Axis labels and title.

...

Other arguments passed to graphics::matplot().

Value

x, invisibly.

See also

split_curves()

Examples

x = sim_farfima(n = 100, d = 0.3, p = 1, q = 0, no_grid = 21, seed = 1)
plot_curves(x)

plot_curves(x, type = "periods", periods = 4)
